panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the crawler process started. Every restart resets all counters; rates here survive it.

panels.title: Torrents / min
panels.description: Torrents persisted per minute, 5 min average.

panels.title: Dial success
panels.description: Share of metainfo requests to peers that returned the metainfo, 5 min average.

panels.title: Dial timeouts
panels.description: Share of attempted dials that ended in a connect timeout, 5 min average. Experimental crawler build only.

panels.title: Queries / torrent
panels.description: Outgoing DHT queries (answered and failed) spent on one persisted torrent, 5 min average.

panels.title: Dials / torrent
panels.description: Metainfo requests to peers spent on one persisted torrent, 5 min average.

panels.title: DHT errors
panels.description: Share of outgoing DHT queries that got no valid answer, all query types, 5 min average.

panels.title: Torrents persisted per minute
panels.description: Total comes from the upstream counter and always exists. The split by discovery source needs the experimental crawler build; tracker sources are folded into v4 and v6.

panels.title: Cost of one torrent
panels.description: Outgoing DHT queries (left axis) and metainfo dials (right axis) per persisted torrent. Lower is cheaper.

panels.title: Metainfo dials: success and timeouts
panels.description: Success is the upstream requester ratio. Dial timeout is the share of attempted dials that timed out on connect (experimental crawler build).

panels.title: DHT query error ratio by query type
panels.description: Share of outgoing queries without a valid answer. Depends on the remote nodes and the network path only, so a jump across all types points at connectivity.

panels.title: Funnel by source, totals over the range
panels.description: Hashes per stage over the selected time range. duplicate is counted before discovered. known includes hashes sent to a rescrape. sample_infohashes_lookup continues the sample_infohashes hashes whose first get_peers found no peers, so it has no discovered column. Tracker sources start at discovered: a tracker announce returned peers. fetch ok is left empty for inbound_peer: incoming peers have no failed fetch stage, so the share would read 100%.

panels.title: Funnel stages per minute ($source)
panels.description: Hashes passing each stage, for the sources picked in the source variable. Log scale: the gap between two lines is the loss between the stages.

panels.title: Where hashes end, per minute ($source)
panels.description: Terminal stages other than persisted. Triage: duplicate, blocked, known, scrape (known, sent to a rescrape), recently_failed. Peer search: lookup_empty, lookup_dropped, lookup_skipped. Fetch: no_candidates, metainfo_failed, already_fetched, banned.

panels.title: Discovered hashes per minute by source
panels.description: New hashes entering the pipeline. Log scale.

panels.title: Metainfo fetch success by source
panels.description: metainfo_ok / (metainfo_ok + metainfo_failed + no_candidates): share of hashes with peers that yielded the metainfo. Sources below 12 fetches per minute are hidden. inbound_peer is left out: incoming peers connect to the crawler, they are not dialed, and have no failed stage.

targets.expr: sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",stage="metainfo_ok",source!="inbound_peer"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*")) / (sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",stage=~"metainfo_ok|metainfo_failed|no_candidates",source!="inbound_peer"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*")) > 0.2)

panels.title: Yield by source
panels.description: persisted / discovered. sample_infohashes_lookup is folded into sample_infohashes here. Sources below 12 hashes per minute are hidden. Log scale.

targets.expr: sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",stage="persisted"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*"), "grp", "sample_infohashes", "source", "sample_infohashes_lookup")) / (sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",stage="discovered"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*"), "grp", "sample_infohashes", "source", "sample_infohashes_lookup")) > 0.2)

panels.title: Lookup cost
panels.description: Iterative get_peers lookups. avg and p90 count answered queries until the first peers arrived (found) or all of them (empty). Sent and limiter refusals are per finished lookup.

panels.title: Triage batch time
panels.description: Average time of one triage batch: asking the store which hashes are known and handing the rest to the next stage. triage is the sample_infohashes path, triage_inbound the hashes from incoming queries.

panels.title: Dial outcomes per minute
panels.description: Metainfo dials by the phase where they ended. mse_ variants are folded into their phase; mse handshake is the encryption handshake itself. limited never left the local rate limiter. Connections accepted from incoming peers are not dials and are left out of every panel in this row.

panels.title: Dial outcome share
panels.description: Same classes as a share of all dials.

panels.title: Dial success by source
panels.description: Successful dials over attempted dials. Sources below 60 dials per minute are hidden.

targets.expr: sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_metainfo_dials_total{job="roj",result=~"ok|ok_.*",source!="inbound_peer"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*")) / (sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_metainfo_dials_total{job="roj",result!="limited",source!="inbound_peer"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*")) > 1)

panels.title: Dial timeout share by source
panels.description: dial_timeout over attempted dials. Sources below 60 dials per minute are hidden.

targets.expr: sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_metainfo_dials_total{job="roj",result="dial_timeout",source!="inbound_peer"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*")) / (sum by (grp) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(rate(roj_dht_crawler_metainfo_dials_total{job="roj",result!="limited",source!="inbound_peer"}[$__rate_interval]), "grp", "$1", "source", "(.*)"), "grp", "trackers v6", "source", "tracker6_.*"), "grp", "trackers v4", "source", "tracker_.*")) > 1)

panels.title: Dials per minute by source
panels.description: All dial records, limited included.

panels.title: Failure results, top 10 over the range
panels.description: Raw result label of failed dials, summed over the selected time range.

panels.title: Successful dials by transport
panels.description: ok is plain TCP, ok_mse encrypted TCP, ok_utp* uTP.

panels.title: Requester rate limiter
panels.description: Metainfo requests by per-address limiter outcome (left axis) and the average wait of a request that waited (right axis).

panels.title: Dial outcome by ping result, totals over the range
panels.description: Rows: was the address a known failure before (dead) or not (new), and did it answer a DHT ping. Columns: how the metainfo dial ended. connected means TCP connected but no metainfo, ok means metainfo fetched, skipped_* means not dialed.

panels.title: Probed peers per minute by class
panels.description: Candidate peers by earlier failure and ping result, dialed or skipped.

panels.title: Connect rate by class
panels.description: Dials that reached a TCP connection (connected or ok) over dials attempted. Shows how well the ping predicts reachability.

targets.expr: sum by (prev, ping) (rate(roj_dht_crawler_peer_probe_total{job="roj",dial=~"ok|connected"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (prev, ping) (rate(roj_dht_crawler_peer_probe_total{job="roj",dial!~"skipped.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Metainfo success by class
panels.description: Dials that fetched the metainfo over dials attempted.

targets.expr: sum by (prev, ping) (rate(roj_dht_crawler_peer_probe_total{job="roj",dial="ok"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (prev, ping) (rate(roj_dht_crawler_peer_probe_total{job="roj",dial!~"skipped.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Dials skipped per minute
panels.description: Peers dropped before the dial: skipped_dead failed before and did not answer the ping, skipped_unseeded belongs to a swarm the trackers report without seeders, skipped_cap is over the per-hash dial cap.

panels.title: DHT pings to peers per minute
panels.description: cached_* were answered from the ping cache, sent_* went on the wire, limited were refused by the outgoing query limiter.

panels.title: Peer ping answer rate
panels.description: answered: sent_ok over pings sent. from cache: share of probes that needed no packet.

panels.title: Peer clients: share of peers, top 10 over the range
panels.description: BitTorrent peers that completed the handshake over the selected time range, by the client named in the peer id. other is a peer id outside the known list.

panels.title: Peer clients over the range
panels.description: Peers that completed the BitTorrent handshake, by client. deliver metainfo: peers that sent the full metainfo over peers that completed the handshake. Per minute columns average over the minutes of the range in which the crawler exported the metric.

panels.title: Peers per minute by client
panels.description: Peers that completed the BitTorrent handshake. Only the largest clients are named; every other client is folded into other. xt is a closed network whose peers answer the handshake and never serve meta info.

panels.title: IPv4 DHT nodes: share of answered queries by implementation
panels.description: Answered outgoing DHT queries over the selected time range by the implementation the node names in the KRPC v field. none sent no v field, other a v outside the known list.

panels.title: IPv6 DHT nodes: share of answered queries by implementation
panels.description: Answered outgoing DHT queries over the selected time range by the implementation the node names in the KRPC v field. none sent no v field, other a v outside the known list.

panels.title: IPv4 node classes over the range
panels.description: Sampling funnel by the kind of DHT node that gave the info hashes. class is the implementation from the KRPC v field, bitmagnet a node id with the stock bitmagnet marker, _short a node that asked to be sampled again within 60 s: bitmagnet* and *_short are mostly other crawlers. needed of fresh: needs_metainfo / fresh, hashes new in this run that were not in the database. fetched of needed: metainfo_ok / needs_metainfo. scrape ok: scrape_ok / (scrape_ok + scrape_error), BEP 33 scrapes of known torrents at that node. Per minute columns average over the minutes of the range in which the crawler exported the metric.

panels.title: IPv6 node classes over the range
panels.description: Sampling funnel by the kind of DHT node that gave the info hashes. class is the implementation from the KRPC v field, bitmagnet a node id with the stock bitmagnet marker, _short a node that asked to be sampled again within 60 s: bitmagnet* and *_short are mostly other crawlers. needed of fresh: needs_metainfo / fresh, hashes new in this run that were not in the database. fetched of needed: metainfo_ok / needs_metainfo. scrape ok: scrape_ok / (scrape_ok + scrape_error), BEP 33 scrapes of known torrents at that node. Per minute columns average over the minutes of the range in which the crawler exported the metric.

panels.title: IPv4 torrents per minute by node class
panels.description: Torrents fetched from hashes sampled at nodes of each class. Dashed lines are the crawler-like classes: bitmagnet* and *_short. Log scale.

panels.title: IPv6 torrents per minute by node class
panels.description: Torrents fetched from hashes sampled at nodes of each class. Dashed lines are the crawler-like classes: bitmagnet* and *_short. Log scale.

panels.title: Torrents per minute from incoming peers
panels.description: Torrents fetched over a connection that a peer opened to the crawler, by the seeders count the tracker scrape reported for the hash. late: the hash had already left the registry; these are part of the classes, not on top of them.

panels.title: Held hashes over the range
panels.description: Hashes the crawler announced itself for and held in the registry. fetched by an incoming peer: a peer connected and sent the metainfo, late fetches included. fetched by the outgoing path: an ordinary dial got it meanwhile. never fetched: left the registry on its deadline and was not fetched later either. Hashes still held are in none of the three.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])), "outcome", "held", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="metainfo_ok"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0), "outcome", "fetched by an incoming peer", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage=~"fetched_outgoing|late_fetched_outgoing"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0), "outcome", "fetched by the outgoing path", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="expired"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0) - (sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage=~"metainfo_ok_late|late_fetched_outgoing"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0), 0), "outcome", "never fetched", "", "")

(label_replace(sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])), "outcome", "held", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="metainfo_ok"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0), "outcome", "fetched by an incoming peer", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage=~"fetched_outgoing|late_fetched_outgoing"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0), "outcome", "fetched by the outgoing path", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="expired"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0) - (sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage=~"metainfo_ok_late|late_fetched_outgoing"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])) * 0), 0), "outcome", "never fetched", "", "")) / scalar(sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="registered"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Registry, late set and open connections
panels.description: registry: hashes held now. late set: hashes that left the registry and still accept a late connection. open connections: incoming connections in progress, right axis.

panels.title: Incoming connections per minute by outcome
panels.description: Every incoming connection ends in exactly one stacked outcome. The peer asked for a hash that is not held: unknown hash, fetched (the crawler has fetched it already), unknown hash, closed swarm (a known closed swarm), unknown hash, other (any other hash), unknown key (an encrypted handshake whose key matches no hash, so the hash stays unknown; counted on its own, not in unknown_hash), unknown hash, busy and unknown hash, duplicate (a connection for a hash we no longer hold that was not served). unknown, not split: unknown_hash connections that carry none of the fetched, closed swarm and other causes, counted before the causes were recorded. Older builds also counted every unknown key here, since they had no unknown key stage, so it stays above zero over a range that includes such a build and is zero only on a build that records the causes. rejected (cap): all connection slots were taken. rejected (per host): too many connections from one host. busy: the hash already had its connections. self: the crawler reached its own listener. Lines, not stacked: active, late, dht and unknown (served) count the connections that matched a held hash, a hash of the late set, a hash joined in the DHT or a hash we no longer hold and served anyway; fetched, peer without metainfo, fetch failed, closed network and self are their outcomes.

panels.title: Incoming peer clients over the range
panels.description: Peers that connected to the crawler and completed the handshake, by client. deliver metainfo: sent the full metainfo. no metainfo of their own: the peer has no metainfo itself and came to get it. Per minute columns average over the minutes of the range in which the crawler exported the metric.

panels.title: Announce packets per second by tracker
panels.description: started plus stopped announces sent to each tracker; a /v6 suffix is the same tracker over IPv6. The red line is the budget of 60 packets per second per tracker.

panels.title: Tracker packets sent over the range
panels.description: Packets sent to each tracker per second by kind: started and stopped announces, scrape requests. Averaged over the minutes of the range in which the crawler exported the metric.

panels.title: DHT announce funnel per minute
panels.description: How the crawler announces itself in the DHT for incoming peers, two paths. Hashes held in no registry or late set after their outgoing fetch failed: queued (dht_queued) for a join, then joined (dht_joined) or join failed (dht_join_failed, no node took the announce or the lookup slots were busy); queue full (dht_queue_full) is a join that found no room in the queue; expired (dht_expired) is a joined hash that left the DHT set at its deadline. Hashes held in the registry: announced (dht_announced, at least one node accepted), announce failed (dht_announce_failed, none did), announce queue full (dht_announce_queue_full, the announce queue had no room). fetched after announce: held hashes fetched by an incoming peer that also had a DHT announce; part of the fetched torrents, not on top.

panels.title: Late set turnover per minute
panels.description: Hashes that left the registry stay in the late set to accept a late connection. evicted: pushed out because the set was full (late_evicted). expired: aged out of the set (late_expired). loaded at start: how many hashes the set took from disk at the last start (late_loaded), right axis.

panels.title: BEP 33 swarm classes of DHT-joined hashes over the range
panels.description: Hashes the crawler joined in the DHT, by the BEP 33 scrape of the two closest nodes: seeded (a node reported seeds), leechers (only downloaders), empty (nobody), unknown (no node answered with filters). scraped is counted before the join, so it exceeds joined by the failed joins. connections: incoming connections for a hash of the class. peer without metainfo: connections whose peer had none. fetched: torrents fetched by an incoming peer. fetched of joined: fetched over joined. fetched of connections: fetched over connections.

targets.expr: (label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_scrape_seeded"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "seeded", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_scrape_leechers"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "leechers", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_scrape_unknown"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "unknown", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_scrape_empty"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "empty", "", ""))

(label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_joined_seeded"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "seeded", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_joined_leechers"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "leechers", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_joined_unknown"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "unknown", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_joined_empty"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "empty", "", ""))

(label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_conn_seeded"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "seeded", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_conn_leechers"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "leechers", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_conn_unknown"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "unknown", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="dht_conn_empty"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "empty", "", ""))

(label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="peer_no_metainfo_dht_seeded"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "seeded", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="peer_no_metainfo_dht_leechers"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "leechers", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="peer_no_metainfo_dht_unknown"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "unknown", "", "") or label_replace((sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer",stage="peer_no_metainfo_dht_empty"}[$__range])) or sum(increase(roj_dht_crawler_hashes_total{job="roj",source="inbound_peer"}[$__range])) * 0), "class", "empty", "", ""))

panels.title: Torrents per minute from DHT-joined hashes by BEP 33 class
panels.description: Torrents fetched by an incoming peer for a hash the crawler joined in the DHT, by the BEP 33 class of the hash at the join: seeded, leechers, unknown, empty.

panels.title: BEP 33 scrape failures per minute
panels.description: BEP 33 scrape queries to the two closest nodes of a hash that gave no usable answer, counted per queried node, up to two per hash, not per hash. no filter: the node answered without BEP 33 filters. timeout: no answer in time or any other error. failed (old stage): the single counter that older builds used for both causes; it stops growing once the two new stages arrive and stays here to keep the history.

panels.title: Extra tracker memberships per minute
panels.description: outgoing fetch failed: held hashes whose outgoing fetch failed for the first time (outgoing_failed), the trigger for extra memberships and DHT joins. extra memberships joined: held hashes that took an extra membership on a further tracker (extra_joined), counted once per hash. fetched with extras: fetched by an incoming peer after an extra membership joined (metainfo_ok_extra); part of the fetched torrents, not on top.

panels.title: Connections for hashes no longer held per minute
panels.description: Connections for a hash that is in no registry, late set or DHT set, served anyway when the connection is plaintext. served: such connections that were accepted (unknown_conn). fetched, peer without metainfo and fetch failed: their outcomes (metainfo_ok_unknown, peer_no_metainfo_unknown, fetch_failed_unknown); each is part of the same-named stacked outcome above, not on top. already in the database: connections dropped before the fetch because the database has the torrent (unknown_known); they are not part of served.

panels.title: Incoming meta info bytes by outcome
panels.description: Bytes incoming peers sent after the handshake, by how their connection ended. metainfo is the connection that completed a meta info, fetched_elsewhere lost the race to another connection of the same torrent, pieces_failed stopped half way and left its pieces for the next peer.

panels.title: Meta info pieces kept between connections
panels.description: resumed: bytes a completed meta info took from earlier connections instead of asking again. partial_idle and partial_evicted: kept pieces dropped unused, after ten idle minutes or to stay inside the byte budget.

panels.title: Unfinished incoming transfers by reason
panels.description: Connections whose meta info transfer stopped before the last piece. rejected is the peer answering a piece request with a reject, timeout the transfer running past its time limit.

panels.title: Peers speaking the DLBT dialect
panels.description: Peers of DLBT based clients greet with a private protocol string. Incoming: connections that used it and the meta infos they delivered. Outgoing: dials retried in the dialect after the standard handshake was closed, by result.

panels.title: Incoming transfers by attempt of the hash
panels.description: Transfers per minute by how many times the info hash has been tried within the last six hours, this one included. A growing share of high attempts means the same hashes come back without finishing.

panels.title: Finished transfers by attempt of the hash
panels.description: Share of transfers that brought the meta info, by how many times the info hash has been tried.

panels.title: Timed out transfers by attempt of the hash
panels.description: Transfers per minute that ran past their time limit, by how many times the info hash has been tried.

panels.title: Swarm classes over the range
panels.description: Hashes that reached the metainfo stage, by how their peers answer a DHT ping. hint_only: every answering peer reports the DHT version of the closed XT network. hint_mixed: some answering peers report it, others do not. regular: peers answer and none reports it. silent: no peer answers. closed swarm: a handshake showed the closed network. skipped without a dial: a hint_only hash left alone on the hint. share fetched: fetched over the hashes that were dialed, so neither skipped without a dial nor no candidates (no peer address to dial) is in the denominator. Per minute columns average over the minutes of the range in which the crawler exported the metric.

panels.title: Hashes left alone per minute
panels.description: Hashes dropped without a fetch attempt or after the closed network showed. closed swarm known: seen before as a closed swarm. closed swarm (handshake): a peer handshake showed the closed network. closed swarm (hint, no dial): every answering peer hinted at it, nobody was dialed. alias known: the second hash of a hybrid torrent that is already stored. recently failed: the fetch failed a short while ago.

panels.title: Dials per minute to closed_hint peers
panels.description: Metainfo dials by result group. closed_hint: the peer answers the DHT ping with the DHT version of the closed XT network. closed network peer: the handshake showed a client of the closed network. no TCP, no uTP: the TCP dial timed out and the uTP retry failed too. handshake failed: the peer closed, reset or stalled during the plain or encrypted handshake.

panels.title: Dials per minute to regular peers
panels.description: Metainfo dials by result group. regular: the peer answers the DHT ping with any other DHT version. closed network peer: the handshake showed a client of the closed network. no TCP, no uTP: the TCP dial timed out and the uTP retry failed too. handshake failed: the peer closed, reset or stalled during the plain or encrypted handshake.

panels.title: Dials per minute to silent peers
panels.description: Metainfo dials by result group. silent: the peer does not answer the DHT ping. closed network peer: the handshake showed a client of the closed network. no TCP, no uTP: the TCP dial timed out and the uTP retry failed too. handshake failed: the peer closed, reset or stalled during the plain or encrypted handshake.

panels.title: BEP 52 torrents per minute
panels.description: Torrents with a v2 info hash. v2 only: no v1 part. hybrid via v2 hash: a hybrid torrent fetched through its v2 hash. duplicate of a fetched hash: such a hybrid whose torrent was fetched moments ago under the other hash; part of the hybrid line, not stored again.

panels.title: Closed clients found by the learner
panels.description: Peer clients the learner treats as a closed network: none of their swarms gave meta info. closed swarms is the number of swarms the learner had seen of the client when it was found closed, set at that moment and at start, not updated afterwards. A client leaves the list when its swarms deliver again.

panels.title: Closed client dials per minute by source
panels.description: Failed dials to a peer of a client the learner treats as closed, by the discovery source of the hash (closed_client_learned).

panels.title: Closed client probes per minute
panels.description: The learner probing clients it treats as closed. probes: dials made to a closed client anyway to check whether it still gives no meta info (closed_client_probe). probes fetched: probes that delivered the metainfo (closed_client_probe_fetched). forgiven: clients taken off the closed list because their swarms deliver again (closed_client_forgiven), right axis.

panels.title: Trackers, totals over the range
panels.description: Outcomes and scrape answers per tracker over the selected time range; a /v6 suffix is the same tracker over IPv6. The outcome columns come from tracker_packets_total, which counts per-hash outcomes, not packets (only the scrape columns are per request), so they do not add up to the packets sent. scrape answered is ok / (ok + timeout). seeded share is the part of scraped hashes the tracker knows seeders for. extra columns: extra memberships on further trackers for held hashes whose outgoing fetch failed; stale means the hash had left or was already a member there, nothing sent.

panels.title: IPv4 trackers: packets per minute by result
panels.description: UDP tracker results, one count per outcome. tracker_packets_total counts per-hash outcomes, not packets (only the scrape results are per request), so it is not comparable with tracker_sent_total, which counts packets on the wire: never divide one by the other. ok, timeout, error and rate_limited are scrape requests (one request carries a batch of hashes), announce_* are announces sent for seeded hashes, hold_* are the memberships kept in a swarm for a held hash (start ok, timeout or error; stop sent, failed or dropped). extra_* are extra memberships on further trackers for held hashes whose outgoing fetch failed: extra_ok, extra_timeout, extra_error, extra_queue_full (the extra queue of the tracker had no room), extra_stale (the hash had left or was already a member there, nothing sent).

panels.title: IPv6 trackers: packets per minute by result
panels.description: UDP tracker results, one count per outcome. tracker_packets_total counts per-hash outcomes, not packets (only the scrape results are per request), so it is not comparable with tracker_sent_total, which counts packets on the wire: never divide one by the other. ok, timeout, error and rate_limited are scrape requests (one request carries a batch of hashes), announce_* are announces sent for seeded hashes, hold_* are the memberships kept in a swarm for a held hash (start ok, timeout or error; stop sent, failed or dropped). extra_* are extra memberships on further trackers for held hashes whose outgoing fetch failed: extra_ok, extra_timeout, extra_error, extra_queue_full (the extra queue of the tracker had no room), extra_stale (the hash had left or was already a member there, nothing sent).

panels.title: IPv4 trackers: scrape answers per minute by swarm class
panels.description: Scrape answers by what the tracker said about the hash: seeded, leechers only, or unknown to it. A hash is counted once per tracker that answered.

panels.title: IPv6 trackers: scrape answers per minute by swarm class
panels.description: Scrape answers by what the tracker said about the hash: seeded, leechers only, or unknown to it. A hash is counted once per tracker that answered.

panels.title: IPv4 announces with peers per minute by seeders bucket
panels.description: Hashes for which an announce returned peers, by the seeders count the scrape reported: 1, 2 to 4, 5 to 19, 20 or more.

panels.title: IPv6 announces with peers per minute by seeders bucket
panels.description: Hashes for which an announce returned peers, by the seeders count the scrape reported: 1, 2 to 4, 5 to 19, 20 or more.

panels.title: IPv4 announce yield by seeders bucket
panels.description: persisted / discovered per seeders bucket: how often an announce that returned peers ends in a new torrent.

panels.title: IPv6 announce yield by seeders bucket
panels.description: persisted / discovered per seeders bucket: how often an announce that returned peers ends in a new torrent.

panels.title: Metainfo success by swarm class
panels.description: Share of fetch attempts that returned the metainfo, by what the trackers said about the swarm when the attempt ended. pending: no tracker had answered yet.

panels.title: Fetch outcome by swarm class, totals over the range
panels.description: Rows: tracker verdict on the swarm. Columns: how the hash ended.

panels.title: Tracker queues per minute
panels.description: Announce queue: seeded hashes accepted after a tracker scrape (announce queued, counted once per hash) or dropped because the queue was full (announce queue full). Scrape queue full: hashes that never reached the trackers because the scrape queue had no room.

panels.title: Busy workers by stage
panels.description: A line flat at its ceiling is a stage working at full capacity.

panels.title: Queued items by stage
panels.description: Items waiting in front of each stage. A queue that stays full marks the stage behind it as the bottleneck.

panels.title: Stage saturation over the range
panels.description: pinned is average busy workers over the maximum seen in the range: close to 100% means the stage sat at its ceiling the whole time.

panels.title: Node pool
panels.description: DHT nodes waiting to be sampled.

panels.title: Metainfo requests per minute
panels.description: Requests to peers for the metainfo: fetched or failed.

panels.title: Metainfo fetch duration
panels.description: Duration of successful requests.

panels.title: Concurrent metainfo requests
panels.description: Requests in flight.

panels.title: Outgoing queries per minute by type
panels.description: Queries sent to other DHT nodes, answered and failed.

panels.title: Failed outgoing queries per minute by type
panels.description: Queries without a valid answer: timeouts and error replies.

panels.title: Answer time by type
panels.description: Average duration of answered queries. The histogram buckets only span 0.1 to 0.5 s, so no percentiles here.

panels.title: Concurrent outgoing queries by type
panels.description: Queries in flight.

panels.title: Incoming queries answered per minute by type
panels.description: Queries from other DHT nodes that got an answer.

panels.title: Incoming queries refused per minute by type
panels.description: Queries answered with an error: rate limited, bad token, unknown method.

panels.title: Routing table size
panels.description: Nodes (left axis) and hashes (right axis) held in the routing table.

panels.title: Routing table churn per minute
panels.description: Entries added to and dropped from the routing table.

panels.title: DHT rate limiters and inbound hashes (experimental crawler build)
DHT datagrams per second by exit
panels.description: DHT datagrams by the tunnel interface they left or arrived through. A remote host always talks to the same exit, and an answer leaves through the exit the query came in on. With a single exit the only series is default.

panels.title: Client limiter: average wait by type
panels.description: Average time an outgoing query spent in the per-address rate limiter.

panels.title: Client limiter: queries parked by type
panels.description: Seconds waited per second, which is the average number of queries sitting in the limiter.

panels.title: Client limiter: abandoned share by type
panels.description: Queries given up while waiting in the limiter, over queries that entered it.

panels.title: Responder: refusals per minute by reason
panels.description: Incoming queries answered with an error, by reason.

panels.title: Responder: limiter refusals per minute
panels.description: Incoming queries refused by the responder rate limiter, by limiter scope.

panels.title: Inbound hashes per minute
panels.description: Info hashes seen in incoming get_peers and announce_peer queries, by what happened to them.

panels.title: Peers by country
panels.description: Peers that completed a BitTorrent handshake over the selected time range, incoming and outgoing together, by the country of their address. The database is DB-IP Country Lite (CC BY 4.0, db-ip.com).

panels.title: Sampled DHT nodes by country
panels.description: DHT nodes that answered sample_infohashes over the selected time range, by the country of their address.

panels.title: Incoming peers: share by country, top 15
panels.description: Peers that connected to us and completed the handshake over the selected time range.

panels.title: Outgoing peers: share by country, top 15
panels.description: Peers we dialled that completed the handshake over the selected time range.

panels.title: Meta infos delivered: share by country, top 15
panels.description: Peers that gave a whole meta info over the selected time range, incoming and outgoing together.

panels.title: Meta infos per 1000 handshakes, top 15 countries by peers
panels.description: How useful the peers of a country are: meta infos delivered per thousand completed handshakes, for the fifteen countries with the most peers.

targets.expr: sort_desc(1000 * sum by (country) (increase(roj_geo_total{job="roj",kind=~"peer_.*",stage="metainfo"}[$__range])) / (sum by (country) (increase(roj_geo_total{job="roj",kind=~"peer_.*",stage="handshake"}[$__range])) and topk(15, sum by (country) (increase(roj_geo_total{job="roj",kind=~"peer_.*",stage="handshake"}[$__range])))))

panels.title: Sampled DHT nodes: share by country, top 15
panels.description: DHT nodes that answered sample_infohashes over the selected time range.

panels.title: Peers of private applications by greeting
panels.description: Incoming peers that greeted with a private protocol string of the DLBT kernel instead of the BitTorrent one, by that string in hex. Each string is one application.

panels.title: Known info hashes
panels.description: Torrents the crawler knows to be stored: loaded from the store at start plus the ones written since.

panels.title: Load at start
panels.description: Time the crawler took to read the known info hashes and the latest swarm readings when it last started.

panels.title: Batches waiting in the spool
panels.description: Batches the server did not take, kept on disk until it does. Anything above zero for long means the store is away.

panels.title: Rows written per minute by table
panels.description: Rows the store accepted. files is the file lists of the torrents, swarms the seeder and leecher readings.

panels.title: Insert time by table
panels.description: Median and 99th percentile of the time one batch took to be written.

panels.title: Batches refused per minute by table
panels.description: Batches the server did not take; they wait in the spool and are sent again every 15 seconds.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the crawler process.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident set size and the Go heap in use.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Bytes received and sent by the process.

panels.title: File descriptors and goroutines
panels.description: Open file descriptors (left axis), roughly one per connection in flight, and goroutines (right axis).

panels.title: Fresh uploads held
panels.description: Share of the uploads that public trackers listed 6 to 24 hours ago which the store already holds. Measured hourly against an aggregator of public trackers.

panels.title: Latest public uploads held, by age of the listing
panels.description: Share of the latest uploads of public trackers, as an aggregator lists them, that the store holds. Young listings are still being found; the older ones show what the crawler misses for good. Measured hourly.

panels.title: Time from a public listing to the store
panels.description: Median time between the listing of an upload on a public tracker and its arrival in the store, over uploads listed 6 to 48 hours ago and found after the listing.
